sloka: स शूलनिर्भिन्नमहाभूजान्तरः प्रविह्वलः शोणितमुद्वमन् मुखात्।ननाद भीमं हनुमान् महाहवे युगान्तमेघस्तनितस्वनोपमम् ।। ६.६७.२० ।।
transliteration: sa śūlanirbhinnamahābhūjāntaraḥ pravihvalaḥ śoṇitamudvaman mukhāt।nanāda bhīmaṁ hanumān mahāhave yugāntameghastanitasvanopamam ।। 6.67.20 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Hanuman struck Kumbhakarna endowed with a rock like frightening body. Overpowered by that blow Kumbhakarna was upset and bespattered with fat and got bathed in blood.
